narr: A predecessor rainfall event set up ahead of the remnants of Tropical Storm Debby. A hot and humid airmass was in place, resulting in a very moist and unstable airmass. A few showers and thunderstorms developed, producing damaging wind gusts across portions of New Jersey, downing trees and wires.
ev: New Jersey state road 31 closed in Pennington in both directions due to flooding.

In Deal, the department of highways reported that New Jersey state road 71 was flooding in both directions. Additionally, a trained spotter provided pictures of multiple cars stalled out in flood waters on Ocean Avenue.
New Jersey state road 66 Eastbound lanes are closed due to flooding for the portion of the road west of NJ35.
Shabakunk Creek near the Sylva Lake Dam flooded. The flood waters entered some buildings near the creek.
Commanck Lane is closed due to Milford Brook flooding.
Flooded roadways, especially in the area of the intersection between Haddonfield Road and Maple Avenue was reported by a trained spotter.
Multiple water rescues reported in the areas of Haddonfield and Collingswood. Time estimated from radar.
Flooding on New Jersey state road 18 in both directions near the intersection with Cranbury Road. All northbound lanes closed.
Flooding on New Jersey state road 35, especially the southbound ramp to Pine Avenue. All lanes of that ramp are closed.
Flash flooding on US 130 near the intersection with Manor Drive and Tenby Chase Drive. Webcam at that location showed at lease one car stuck in flood waters.
Pictures shared on social media showed multiple roads flooded in Edgewater Park. Time estimated from nearby reports.
